IncidentBot: SEV2 - multiple serving replicas in us-west-2 are restarting with CUDA OOM / container crashes; spikes in 503s (~1% traffic) on /v1/generate. Suspected root: paged-attention allocator + KV cache fragmentation causing slow memory growth. On-call: Maya.
Maya: I'm taking this. grabbing node logs and core dumps. any quick wins to reduce memory pressure?
Ashish: logs show repeated failures: 
```
E cuda: cudaErrorLaunchFailure at attention_kernel.cu:234
E runtime: attempted allocation of 2.1GiB failed
I kv_cache: pager: page_count +128K -> +512K in 2m
W allocator: slab fragment high-water ~78% after GC
```
Ashish: pretty clear pattern: slow creep in resident set then kernel launch fails, container restarts. Looks like fragmentation in the paged allocator prevents large contiguous allocations.
Priya: Observed increased evictions on a small subset of shards. Customer impact: two enterprise customers saw retries -> degraded p99. CS notified?
Jorge: ppl from those accounts alerted. CS will queue a follow-up if we need an extended mitigation or credits.
Maya: Actions taken:
- lowered kv cache eviction_threshold from 0.65 -> 0.45 on affected pool (hotfix)
- triggered ops job: `/ops/compact-kv --pool=us-west-2-paged --force` to compact pages
- rolling restart of 3/6 replicas with `graceful_restart=true` to avoid mass cold-KV penalties
Maya: Also routing change: temporarily route 10% traffic to dedicated fallback model (smaller quantized variant) to reduce peak allocator load.
DeployBot: Auto-scaler attempted +2 nodes (3->5). One new node failed init with container crash during warmup; kernel logs similar to above.
Ashish: Continuing with compaction; collecting heap profiles and nvprof traces. Saving /var/log/serving/hv-dump-1772468100.tar.gz to S3 for postmortem.
Priya: Suggest we enable short-term prefix caching bypass for large-context calls (reduces paged-attn pressure) until compaction finishes.
Maya: Done. Enabled bypass flag on gateway for 5m windows, monitoring. Synthetic tests show reduced OOMs, real traffic error rate down ~0.3% -> 0.05%.
Maya: Handing off active watch to Ashish for the night at 1772468200. If restarts persist, next step: fallback routing 30% and schedule node-level kernel upgrades / allocator patch.
Ashish: Ack. Will keep compaction running and collect post-compaction fragmentation metrics. I'll open PM ticket and link logs.
IncidentBot: Update: incident remains SEV2 -> monitoring. Next automated alert threshold set to 3 restarts/10m for the pool.
Maya: Thanks team. Jorge keep CS updated. Priya please coordinate evals for quantized fallback quality checks.
Jorge: on it. Posting templated customer message in #customer-notify.
Ashish: handover notes in /incidents/1772468100 — will attach heap dumps and nvprof, and run smaller reproducer to validate allocator fix tomorrow.
Maya: leaving channel, paging Ashish for any escalations. :thumbsup:
